## RECALL-2 — Recall route, hidden strings, and scratch drawing

### Files created
- `src/features/recall/RecallPage.tsx`
- `src/features/recall/RecallToolbar.tsx`
- `src/features/recall/useScratchConnections.ts`
- `src/features/recall/recall.css`
- `tests/recall/RecallPage.test.tsx`
- `e2e/recall.spec.ts`

### Files changed
- `src/board/BoardCanvas.tsx`
- `src/board/BoardScene.ts`
- `src/board/StringLayer.ts`
- `src/app/routes.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`

### Behavior exercised
- **Entry:** `/case/:caseId/recall` loads the case through the read-only `CaseRepositoryPort` boundary. The canvas receives `connections: []` and a separate neutral scratch layer. Card titles, images, type, and world positions remain in the snapshot.
- **In-memory fit:** measured two-card fixture fit `{ x: 400, y: 330, scale: 1 }`; stored viewport remained byte-for-byte unchanged and `viewportDirty` stayed `false`.
- **Gestures:** the existing thread-anchor gesture is reused. A scratch drop emits `onScratchDrop({ fromCardId, toCardId })`; it never calls `onConnectionDrop` or a repository.
- **Reversed pairs:** truth `lower → topmost`, scratch `topmost → lower`; Check exposed `remembered=1`, `missed=0`, `extra=0`, `typeMismatch=0`.
- **Reset:** clears scratch and check state, stays in recall.
- **Exit:** non-empty scratch opens the in-app `Exit recall?` dialog; “Keep practising” stays, “Discard and exit” clears and returns to the board.
- **Route change / reload:** scratch store is reset on unmount and on reload; no blocking dialog on route change.
- **Strings:** scratch strings use the neutral `--color-ink-muted` palette, solid stroke, no truth type styling, and the layer has no animation state, so reduced motion is honored by construction.
- **Teardown:** the new scratch layer is added to `BoardScene` and destroyed with the scene; the real-browser route changes completed without console errors.
- **No writes:** component test spies over 10 `CaseRepository` mutations, 5 `ConnectionRepository` mutations, IndexedDB `open/transaction/add/put/delete/clear`, and `localStorage` writes observed **zero calls** across enter, draw, check, remove, reset, and exit.
- **Culling/textures:** unchanged; the scratch layer reuses `StringLayer` culling (200 px margin) and adds no textures. Existing board culling/texture tests remain green.

### Contract consumed by the board
`BoardSnapshot` is still plain:
`{ caseId, caseTitle, cards[{ id, title, type, position, image? }], connections?, scratchConnections? }`

`BoardCanvas` now accepts:
`mode?: 'browse' | 'recall'`, `scratchConnections?: BoardStringConnection[]`, `onScratchDrop?: (drop: { fromCardId; toCardId: string | null }) => void`.

`RecallPage` consumes only `getCase`, `listCards`, `listConnections`, and `listAttachments`; it emits scratch intents to `recallStore` and navigation on exit.

### Shared-file changes to preserve
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`: adds a `Recall` link in the header when the board is ready and has cards.
- `src/app/routes.tsx`: `/case/:caseId/recall` now lazy-loads the real page and accepts optional `recallRepository` / `loadRecallRepository`, defaulting to the board repository/loader.
- `ui-engineer` must preserve the `RecallPage`/`RecallToolbar` props and add the results panel in **RECALL-3** rather than replacing the Check seam. `foundation-engineer` must preserve the lazy route so PixiJS stays out of the initial chunk.

### Bundle evidence
Final preview build:
- `dist/assets/BoardCanvas-CsPbx3wx.js` — **348,522 B** (102.59 kB gzip), contains `pixi.js`.
- `dist/assets/RecallPage-DOSgz8rV.js` — **13,677 B** (4.89 kB gzip), no `pixi` marker.
- `dist/assets/index-DCuRDBRo.js` — **267,821 B** (85.28 kB gzip), no `pixi` marker.
- Separate `RecallPage` and `BoardCanvas` chunks confirmed.

### Validation
- `npm test -- tests/recall/RecallPage.test.tsx` — **3 passed**.
- `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/recall.spec.ts` — **2 passed** (desktop, tablet-landscape); phone skipped by design because scratch drawing is pointer-only.
- `npm run typecheck` — passed.
- `npm run lint` — passed.
- `npm test` — **69 files / 894 tests passed**.
- `npm run build` (run by the e2e command) — passed.

### Performance / remaining verification
- No per-frame work was added. The scratch layer redraws only on snapshot/camera changes, like the truth layer, and adds one batched Graphics path.
- The **45 FPS at 150 cards on the target tablet** target still needs human verification; no FPS measurement was claimed here.
- Broader pre-existing e2e failures were observed outside this task’s required commands (`e2e/board.spec.ts` pan/fallback assertions and the second-thread case in `e2e/connections.spec.ts`). They reproduce with the Recall link removed and are unrelated to RECALL-2.

handoff.summary: Implemented RECALL-2: lazy recall route, hidden truth strings, neutral in-memory scratch layer, thread-anchor scratch drawing, individual removal, reset, confirmed exit, route-change/reload discard, keyboard controls, component tests, and a real-browser recall journey. Required tests, typecheck, lint, full unit suite, and build all pass.
decisions: RecallPage never passes truth connections to the canvas; it keeps them in page state only for the Check comparison.
BoardScene owns a separate neutral StringLayer for scratch pairs so truth association/provenance colors cannot leak.
Recall entry hydrates the stored viewport then applies a temporary fit, never scheduling a viewport write.
Scratch additions/removals and Check only touch the in-memory store and pure comparison; no repository or storage import exists on that path.
Exit uses an in-app Dialog only for non-empty scratch; browser back, route change, and reload discard silently.
Individual scratch removal is a keyboard-reachable DOM list in RecallToolbar, while drawing remains pointer-only.

BoardScratchDrop: { fromCardId: string; toCardId: string | null }
useScratchConnections: scratchConnections, count, hasScratch, addScratch, addScratchPair, removeScratch, removeScratchPair, resetScratch, resetOnExit
RecallToolbar props: scratchConnections, cards, checked, onCheck, onReset, onExit, onRemove

warnings: Broader board/connection e2e specs still fail in this environment independently of RECALL-2 (board pan and duplicate-link selector; connections second-thread menu); they were not modified and are outside the required validation.
The phone e2e project is skipped for the pointer path; keyboard entry/reset/exit are covered by component tests, not a phone browser journey.
The Check action currently exposes counts through data attributes and a status message only; the RECALL-3 accessible results panel remains intentionally unimplemented.
validationLimitations: 45 FPS at 150 cards on the target tablet was not measured; board-feel and FPS still require human review.
Culling and texture-cap behavior were not re-measured because these layers were not changed; existing board tests remain green.
A component test with a mocked Pixi boundary is supplemented by the real-browser recall journey for scratch drawing and route teardown.
